column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 diary / Prague

column2: Month □, Day × — Clear
He's awake...
He's awake...
He's awake, he's awake...
But he has lost his $$記憶$$ of the past...
Is this punishment? Or retribution for $$罪$$!?
Month △, Day ○ — Rain Again and again, I commit $$罪$$...
Without atoning for it, I commit $$罪$$ again...
Disgusting me.
Shameless me...
Perhaps I'm only dreaming an impossible dream...
Perhaps I'm only afflicted with $$熱病$$...
Am I afraid? Do I want to forget? Or do I want someone to hold me...?
Disgusting me.
Shameless me...
Month ◇, Day ◎ — Cloudy
To go on longing for you while you never wake...
A secret of mine no one can condemn, as long as I don't speak it aloud...
But in my heart...
a knife called $$罪$$ pierces it, and $$血$$ called $$愛$$ weeps tears...
Was our meeting a $$罪$$?
Is longing for you a $$罪$$...?
Is that why you never wake...?
How many days has it been...
How many days will it be tomorrow...?
The hesitation scars on my wrists bear witness to each day you sleep...
Month ○, Day × — Clear
Even as time passes...
there are pains that cannot be forgotten...
There are people who, when they want to cry,
cannot cry...
That shedding tears makes you forget— what a careless lie.
Such shallow feelings...
In the end, people are alone...
If someone tells you that, perhaps that's all there is to it, but...
Still, I...
I want to see your smile one more time...
Month ○, Day ■ — Clear
I'm afraid of the night...
A dream where he disappears...
The more I wish for him, the more I search...
A dream where he disappears... .....
He disappears... from my arms...
If it can stay only a dream, don't disappear...
